_comment: Single source of truth for the local servers the AI menu detects: servers the user installed and runs, which answer the OpenAI Chat Completions dialect (GET <base_url>/models, POST <base_url>/chat/completions). The driver never installs or starts them: it lists one only when its models endpoint answers, and sends it the requests of the openai format of api_providers.json, with no key unless the user gives one or the server's own settings file holds one (discovery.config_files key_key, read only for a running loopback server and never logged). A server's id must not be a provider id of api_providers.json. base_url is each project's documented default port on 127.0.0.1, the IPv4 loopback every one of them binds by default; _source names where it was read. The IP literal, as for Ollama and MLX, keeps the probe off the name localhost, which a client may resolve to ::1 first (where these servers do not listen), send through the system proxy, or answer slowly (#99). llama-server (llama.cpp) and LocalAI both listen on port 8080 by default, so one probe covers both and the row names both. A server is probed only while its process runs (discovery.process_names: the executable's file name; discovery.command_lines: a command-line fragment), at the port its command line passes (discovery.port_flags, discovery.address_flags), else the port of its settings file (discovery.config_files: per OS, dir or the folder named in dir_file, file, dotted port_key, optional dotted key_key), else a port its process listens on, and only then at base_url's default port (_shared/lua/llm/local_server_ports.lua). When the process list cannot be read, a server is still probed at the port of its settings file, else at a port a process of its name listens on, else at base_url's default port.

request_fields._comment: Body fields every driver adds to each Chat Completions request sent to a local server, never to a cloud provider, and never over a field the request already sets. Hybrid reasoning models (Qwen3, Qwen3.5, DeepSeek-R1 distills...) think by default; served locally they write their reasoning as plain text, without <think> tags, until max_tokens runs out, so a prediction gets no answer. Their chat templates read enable_thinking from chat_template_kwargs (mlx-lm/oMLX, llama.cpp server, vLLM, LM Studio); a '/no_think' suffix in the prompt does not stop Qwen3.5. A template that does not know the flag ignores it. Keys starting with _ are documentation.

omlx.label: oMLX
omlx._source: github.com/jundot/omlx: README ('Any OpenAI-compatible client can connect to http://localhost:8000/v1'), omlx/settings.py (host 127.0.0.1, port 8000), omlx/server.py (GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions; a key only when one is configured).

discovery._source: github.com/jundot/omlx: omlx/process_title.py (setproctitle 'omlx-server' replaces the whole command line, so its --port is not visible), omlx/settings.py (settings.json in OMLX_BASE_PATH, else the folder written in ~/Library/Application Support/oMLX/base-path, else ~/.omlx; key server.port, default 8000; --port and OMLX_PORT override it; auth.api_key, required on every request unless auth.skip_api_key_verification), apps/omlx-mac ServerProcess.swift (the app starts 'python -m omlx.cli serve --port <its setting>').

lmstudio.label: LM Studio
lmstudio._source: github.com/lmstudio-ai/docs 1_developer/3_openai-compat/index.mdx (base_url http://localhost:1234/v1; GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions with text and images).

discovery._source: LM Studio documents its port only in the app and 'lms server start --port'; its settings file layout is undocumented, so its listening ports are read.

llamacpp.label: llama.cpp / LocalAI
llamacpp._source: github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp tools/server/README.md (--host default 127.0.0.1, --port default 8080; GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions; images with --mmproj). github.com/mudler/LocalAI core/cli/run.go (LOCALAI_ADDRESS default :8080).

discovery._source: llama.cpp tools/server/README.md (--port); LocalAI core/cli/run.go (--address [host]:port). Neither keeps a settings file.

jan.label: Jan
jan._source: github.com/janhq/jan docs/src/pages/docs/desktop/api-server.mdx (host 127.0.0.1, port 1337, prefix /v1; a key only when one is set).

discovery._source: Jan sets its API server port in the app; its settings layout is undocumented, so its listening ports are read.
